description: Rename or reschedule an existing event in Apple Calendar. If the user provided the event title and requested change, call this directly. The app finds the event by title and original date, so a separate agenda lookup is unnecessary. Pass the original date or a known event ID if available.

params.name: title
params.description: Existing event title, for finding the event or labelling the confirmation.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event identifier from a prior agenda lookup, if available.

params.name: new_start
params.description: New start. Use ISO 8601 with a time zone offset for an exact time.

params.name: new_end
params.description: New end. Leave out to preserve duration. Use ISO 8601 with a time zone offset for an exact time.

evals.utterance: Move tomorrow's Design Review to 3 PM tomorrow
